mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, application_code, portal_slug, application_name, suite_code, icon, description, status, design_status, last_publish_version, last_publish_time, options, portal_config, ai_assistant_config, del_flag, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time

SELECT a.id AS id, a.application_code AS applicationCode, a.portal_slug AS portalSlug, a.application_name AS applicationName, a.suite_code AS suiteCode, s.suite_name AS suiteName, a.icon AS icon, a.description AS description, a.status AS status, a.design_status AS designStatus, a.last_publish_version AS lastPublishVersion, a.last_publish_time AS lastPublishTime, a.options AS options, a.portal_config AS portalConfig, a.ai_assistant_config AS aiAssistantConfig, COALESCE(object_stats.object_count, 0) AS objectCount, COALESCE(entry_stats.entry_count, 0) AS entryCount, COALESCE(entry_stats.active_entry_count, 0) AS activeEntryCount, COALESCE(binding_stats.flow_count, 0) AS flowCount, (COALESCE(binding_stats.extension_count, 0) + COALESCE(extension_stats.extension_count, 0)) AS extensionCount, COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(a.options, '$.inAppBuilder.nodes'), 0) AS pageCount, (CASE WHEN COALESCE(object_stats.primary_count, 0) = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(entry_stats.active_entry_count, 0) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS problemCount, a.create_by AS createBy, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_time AS updateTime FROM ai_business_application a LEFT JOIN ai_business_suite s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.suite_code = a.suite_code AND s.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ao.tenant_id, ao.application_id, COUNT(1) AS object_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ao.object_role = 'PRIMARY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS primary_count FROM ai_business_application_object ao INNER JOIN ai_business_object o ON o.tenant_id = ao.tenant_id AND o.id = ao.object_id AND o.del_flag = '0' WHERE ao.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY ao.tenant_id, ao.application_id ) object_stats ON object_stats.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND object_stats.application_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, application_id, COUNT(1) AS entry_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_entry_count FROM ai_business_app WHERE del_flag = '0' AND application_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tenant_id, application_id ) entry_stats ON entry_stats.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND entry_stats.application_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, target_id AS application_id, SUM(CASE WHEN binding_type IN ('FLOW', 'APPROVAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flow_count, SUM(CASE WHEN binding_type NOT IN ('FLOW', 'APPROVAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS extension_count FROM ai_business_binding WHERE target_type = 'APPLICATION' GROUP BY tenant_id, target_id ) binding_stats ON binding_stats.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND binding_stats.application_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, application_id, COUNT(1) AS extension_count FROM ai_business_extension WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY tenant_id, application_id ) extension_stats ON extension_stats.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND extension_stats.application_id = a.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY a.update_time DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY a.update_time DESC, a.id DESC
SELECT a.id AS id, a.portal_config AS portalConfig, a.create_by AS createBy FROM ai_business_application a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.del_flag = '0'

WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.status = 1 AND a.last_publish_version IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_business_application_version published_version WHERE published_version.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND published_version.application_id = a.id AND published_version.version_no = a.last_publish_version AND published_version.del_flag = '0' ) ORDER BY a.last_publish_time DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id AS id, a.application_code AS applicationCode, a.portal_slug AS portalSlug, a.application_name AS applicationName, a.suite_code AS suiteCode, s.suite_name AS suiteName, a.icon AS icon, a.description AS description, a.status AS status, a.design_status AS designStatus, a.last_publish_version AS lastPublishVersion, a.last_publish_time AS lastPublishTime, a.options AS options ,a.portal_config AS portalConfig ,a.ai_assistant_config AS aiAssistantConfig FROM ai_business_application a LEFT JOIN ai_business_suite s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.suite_code = a.suite_code AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.del_flag = '0' AND (a.application_code = #{identifier} OR a.portal_slug = #{identifier}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.application_code = #{identifier} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1

INNER JOIN ai_business_application_version published_version ON published_version.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND published_version.application_id = a.id AND published_version.version_no = a.last_publish_version AND published_version.del_flag = '0' WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.status = 1 AND a.last_publish_version IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(published_version.snapshot_json, '$.application.portalSlug')) = #{portalSlug} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM sys_role r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.del_flag = 0 AND r.role_status = 1 AND r.id IN
#{roleId}

mapper.update: UPDATE ai_business_application SET design_status = CASE WHEN design_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'CHANGED') THEN 'CHANGED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{applicationId} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE ai_business_application a INNER JOIN ai_business_application_object ao ON ao.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND ao.application_id = a.id AND ao.object_id = #{objectId} AND ao.del_flag = '0' SET a.design_status = CASE WHEN a.design_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'CHANGED') THEN 'CHANGED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END, a.update_time = NOW() WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.del_flag = '0'

UPDATE ai_business_application SET design_status = 'PUBLISHED', last_publish_version = #{versionNo}, last_publish_time = #{publishTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{applicationId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_business_application WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE
